token-faq-answer-1: No, your tokens do not expire - our system is totally flexible and allows you to access our opportunities as and when it suits your business needs.
token-faq-question-2: How many tokens can I use on a project?
token-faq-answer-2: Tokens are used against a single package on a project, so if there are two packages on a project you are interested in, you will use 2 tokens.
token-faq-question-3: What happens if I never hear from the client or receive the enquiry?
token-faq-answer-3: In the rare event you are removed from the interested contractors list and do not make it on to the procurement schedule, we will credit the token after a period of 30days.
token-faq-question-4: What happens if I decline the tender?
token-faq-answer-4: You are not obliged to return a price, however your token will not be credited as we have made the connection to the client.

clients-say: What our clients say about us
clients-say-text-1:
Base underfloor heating have been working in collaboration with prosper for the last 12 months and have found
them to be an excellent company to work with.Prosper offer a very professional service and offer excellent high quality
construction opportunities ,with Base underfloor heating now securing a number of high calibre projects to date.
Base underfloor heating would highly recommend the service offers by Prosper.
clients-say-text-2: We have been with Prosper for nearly 20 Months and had several enquiries. We have had many repeat quotations from companies during this period. It was good to hear that we have secured the Kilburn Grange alteration works and hope to continually work with the main contractor through the C-Link portal.
clients-say-text-3: It's been refreshing to work with Prosper in supporting the vital flow of projects in the pipeline. Having a company that understand our business and products and being able to recommend Dorplan for projects gives a great start to constructive conversations with contractors. We all well know what resource it can take to break fresh ground with new clients or projects and to have Prosper in the background doing this and connecting people is a distinct advantage in our business.
clients-say-text-4: Having worked along side Prosper for a number of years we've developed a close business relationship. Their approach and commitment to contributing and assisting us in our growth is one we value highly and will continue to value for the future.
clients-say-text-5: My experience working with Prosper has been very exciting and positive, they're a great team. I have tendered multiple opportunities and secured works that are now live on site projects.
clients-say-text-6: We signed up with Prosper in 2017 and have registered our interest on a number of projects via the online portal. We were sent details from the main contractors for a number of projects. We have just secured our first package via Prosper in excess of £110K. Paul & the team are great guys, and from our first meeting with Paul, I always felt Prosper was going to be good for our company. I would highly recommend Prosper to anyone looking to create new leads and contacts within the construction industry.
clients-say-text-7: I have been working with Chris and Paul for several months now and have found them both to be personable, cheerful and very professional. Paul has been very proactive with phone calls to offer advise and support on how to increase the chances of winning projects, which is very much appreciated. I am also impressed by the set up of the system, it is easy to use and contains a lot of detail. I am happy to be a customer and will definitely continue working with them.
clients-say-text-8: Prosper gave us the opportunity to engage with new clients and we have our first project secured since joining back in October 2019
clients-say-text-9:
I first came across Prosper a couple of years ago when it was initially trading as C-Link. It was through the power of LinkedIn Paul and myself became in contact and from then we met to discuss how the platform works. At the time it was a pay monthly fee and the jobs were put on an online “hub” style platform where you would then decide which jobs suited yourself and from there tenders were sent etc. For myself being a small business this didn't really work as I didn't have time to be in an office and chasing tenders as I was often on site. So it was with that it didn't at first work for myself. 

Two years later and what a change, Paul got in touch last year around June and gave a brief explanation of how himself and Chris have tweaked the way the platform works and the monthly payments have now been replaced with a “no win, no fee” style contract which works excellently for all parties involved. The team at Prosper will guide and support you through the full tender process, they basically become part of the team. Both Paul and Chris are more than approachable with questions and I feel very at ease asking them any questions in relation to a tender even if I may come across a little naive to the commercial market by doing so. 

Having been back involved just over 6 months. I have actively priced 4 projects ranging from residential to larger commercial projects all direct with the developer. This has progressed to being awarded one contract which we are currently on site with and being well in the running for a couple more. 

Prosper has allowed my business to move into a market we once would have struggled to enter, as well as an area of the country we wouldn't have chance to tender for, unless paying ridiculous subscription fees to a tender portal or similar. 

We look forward to working with the team at Prosper in the future and building relationships with clients and developers. Great work guys.
clients-say-text-10: We've been awarded a new project with a new client by accessing Prosper services! Professional team & outstanding service!
clients-say-text-11:
In the short time we have been with Prosper we have been so impressed with not only the communication and dedication they clearly show, but the quality of the leads and prospects. It's easy to get lost in the amount of Tenders you price to simply not hear a thing, which is time lost.

With Prosper we are given clear and precise information regarding the opportunity available and assisted whenever needed throughout the process which turns time lost into time well spent. We are currently half way through our first project we won through prosper and would recommend them to anyone.
clients-say-text-12: I am very grateful for Paul and his team at Prosper. With their platform, help and guidance, I have managed to secure a £28,000 new build project and currently looking to secure many more in the near and distance future, as there is a constant flow of worthy tenders to bid for. I would highly recommend them.
clients-say-text-13:
Having been involved with Prosper since its inception, we have always found Chris and his partners to be very interested in promoting our company and have always gone the extra mile to assist and ensure all our company information on the web is accurate, up to date and relevant to our business and our companies strengths.
 
The promotion has worked extremely well, resulting in work coming to AAC that we would never have been asked to quote or known about.
